scenarios.title: Deploy the exact verified Server, Dashboard, Worker, and ProcessHost payload
passCriteria: Build and runtime manifests identify the same complete release.
The running Server and Worker entries and Dashboard match the approved runtime hashes.
Persistent configuration, accounts, history, and recovery journals remain preserved.

scenarios.title: Exercise native production entries in an isolated synthetic deployment
passCriteria: The existing investigation-acceptance/run.mjs passes using prebuilt current source.
Cancellation, Server reopen, Worker restart, checkpoint resume, and owned process cleanup are independently observed.
The fixture has external writes disabled, no GitHub token, and no real model.

scenarios.title: Exercise the deployed Dashboard against the current native Server
passCriteria: Real application routes, sign-in, source lists, Task/report navigation, and Worker observations agree with the native API.
Select findings, Preview, Confirm preparation, optional editing, and unknown/conflict recovery preserve the exact prepared payload.
No actual GitHub dispatch occurs without separate exact-scope approval.
Light/dark, narrow layouts, keyboard focus, and retained drafts are inspected on the final deployed assets.

scenarios.title: Accept the selected Windows task-hosting and cooperative shutdown policy
passCriteria: Server starts under its configured boot identity and restart attempts remain bounded.
UI Worker only starts in the intended interactive logon session; logged-out or Session 0 execution cannot be accepted as UI-ready.
Stop requests invoke native shutdown; a timeout or unconfirmed cleanup remains a failure and cannot trigger an overlapping replacement.
A host restart and a subsequent user logon preserve database/account configuration and recover task ownership without replaying completed work.

scenarios.title: Rehearse a consistent stopped-runtime backup and isolated restore
passCriteria: All database writers, relay companions, and Worker attempts are confirmed stopped before copying.
Back up the complete persistent roots, required SQLite sidecars, private configuration, and journals with protected ACLs.
Restore to fresh isolated roots with external writes disabled and no intake or live Worker claims.
Account identity, reports, scheduler state, and recovery journals match; the original runtime and data remain untouched.

scenarios.title: Measure a declared sustained workload against explicit throughput and storage limits
passCriteria: The predeclared workload actually completes and the capacity receipt passes every explicit threshold.
Samples cover a continuous process generation with available DB/WAL/filesystem measurements.
Observe retained and expired evidence, protected follow-up dependencies, and physical storage after cleanup.
Sampling claims do not imply allocated-block compaction, inter-sample peak bounds, or power-loss durability.
